$comment: Optional ARD configuration. Copy to ard.config.json only if you need to change something: without it, ARD is enabled and the MCP server and OpenAPI API are discovered automatically from the package. Keys starting with $ or _ are ignored. See docs/ARD.md.
_publisher: Optional FQDN for urn:air:<publisher>:… identifiers. Default: the site's host without www. Set it to keep identifiers identical on staging.
_autoDiscover: Turn off an auto-discovered resource type without touching the rest.
_overrides: Replace generated terms, keyed by resource kind (mcp, openapi, a2a, skills, custom) or by identifier. null removes a term.

representativeQueries: Which Ranatec shield box fits a 5G smartphone test?
Compare the RI 268 and RI 270 tunable filters
Request a quote for two RI 181 shield boxes

_a2a: Register A2A agents only when their agent card is really published.
_skills: Register Agent Skills (format md | json | zip | gzip) only when the file is really published.
_entries: Any other agentic resource, written as an ARD entry. identifier is derived from namespace + displayName when omitted; a relative url is resolved against the site URL; exactly one of url / data.
